newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha cargo surplus depressing spot market.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha cargo surplus depressing spot market.

text.p: European spot naphtha markets were slightly softer on Tuesday with unsold cargoes and a dearth of demand weighing on prices in NWE and the Med.

Traders said unsold cargoes were putting pressure on the front-end of the market, pegging spot prices back to parity with July paper. Prompt and July paper deliveries for pipeline spec cargoes were talked around $173/$176 a tonne cif NWE.
Forward sentiment indicators swaps showed a small contango developing further out with July swaps talked $174/$176 and August around $175/$177.
